_comment: 🦌 BlankTB Portal Backend Egg - FastAPI (Private GitHub Repo)

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update -y
apt install -y git python3 python3-venv python3-pip
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
git clone https://{{PAT}}@github.com/BlankTheDeer/gba.git --branch dev --single-branch backend_src
cd backend_src/backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
deactivate
echo "Backend installed successfully 🦌"

variables.name: PAT
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with read-only access to private BlankTheDeer/gba repo.

variables.name: MONGO_URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection URI for BlankTB Portal.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT signing secret for authentication tokens.
